evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'this should take about ten to fifteen minutes and we'll be able to provide you an accurate estimate' but does not wait explicitly for a yes — customer says 'Okay' but rep immediately moves to 'let's go ahead and get you quoted then' without a clear confirmation gate.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: 'Can I have your first and last name? Sure, Roberta. Last name L-E-L-L-I-S.' Date: 'what date are you planning to move' → November 6–13 window → Thursday or Friday the 13th discussed. City-to-city: same building (8th floor to 4th floor, 7719 Montrose Boulevard). Size: 'just be moving like technically five items' (bed, mattress, couch, TV).
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep goes straight into probing for special items and address without asking 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Partial — got floor/stories (8th to 4th), elevator present, address. Missing: property type (apartment confirmed by context only), number of rooms (not asked), walking distance (not asked), additional rooms (not asked), special considerations (asked once early, not probed further), additional stops (not asked). Box count mentioned ad-hoc by customer, not systematically asked by rep.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: No. Packing is mentioned by customer ('can I get a quote without boxes? And then possibly maybe two. Okay, sure thing. So yeah, can you provide me your address? But let just give me the quote with boxes.') but rep never probes or formally offers packing services.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: No. Customer initiates the boxes question; rep does not ask a typical box count question or ask about overflow items like 'china or book collections.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial. Rep gives a range ('two and a half hours' minimum) and a figure ('$540 $545 for the two and a half hours') but does not anchor to a typical box/furniture count for the home size or personalize beyond 'within the same building.' Later: 'Saturday day, it's $580' (+$35–$40 for weekend).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial. Trip fee mentioned ('address is outside of the free service area, there's just a one time trip fee but it's already included'). No explicit mention of 'not a guess,' 2.5-hour minimum, or 15-minute increments beyond the minimum itself. No upfront disclosure of overnight fees or packing materials before customer asked.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep says 'So let's go ahead and get you on the schedule then' and moves directly to booking without pausing to ask 'does that feel fair?' or wait for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: None. No mention of on-time guarantee, discount terms, or any version of Einstein's punctuality promise.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: None. No mention of No Worries Damage Coverage, $2,000 coverage, no-deductible framing, or built-in-to-rate language.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. Rep never summarizes or 'closes' the Two Promises section — it was not delivered, so there is nothing to close.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway. Rep asks 'do you have any other questions or clarification?' — a generic yes/no question with no real concern-mining language like 'what's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' was asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Rep says 'So let's go ahead and get you on the schedule then' and 'let's go ahead and get you on the schedule today' but never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or similar explicit acceptance ask. Customer volunteers to book but rep does not ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: True. Rep says 'there's no deposit' and 'Whenever you confirm the schedule with me... you have a slot with us' — rate-lock language implied in 'confirm the schedule' and slot reservation, though not stated as 'your rate is locked in.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (Saturday November 14th), arrival window (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM), addresses (7719 Montrose Boulevard, Apartment 810, floors 8 to 4), phone/email (email repeated, no phone recorded on call). Missing: explicit crew size confirmation (rep does not state how many movers), no notes left for crew about customer concerns (customer mentioned sister had used Einstein, rep acknowledged but did not document crew notes). Confirmation email promised but not detailed on call itself.

top_strength: Jev navigated a simple same-building move efficiently, gathered core discovery info (name, date window, address, floor-to-floor), and locked in a booking with clear pricing comparison (weekday vs. weekend rates) and no-deposit terms.
coaching_note: Skip the generic 'any questions?' at the end and ask 'What's still concerning you about this move?' before booking — and deliver the On-Time Guarantee and Damage Coverage promises before the ask, so the customer feels fully protected before they say yes.
